{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfyKiiuEW9WGanrXrLc54","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01HQ1fjaYMReMG3dMX2f1arX","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261012-111947/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-cc-medium_mpi_r2/floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp","content":"#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr unsigned int INF = 1000000000;\nconstexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;\n\n// Index calculation for flattened 2D array\ninline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {\n    return j * n + i;\n}\n\n// Contiguous block of matrix rows owned by one MPI rank\nstruct RowBlock {\n    size_t start;  // first global row\n    size_t count;  // number of rows\n};\n\n// Block row distribution: the first (numNodes % numProcs) ranks each get one extra row\nRowBlock rowBlockOf(const int rank, const int numProcs, const size_t numNodes) {\n    const size_t r = static_cast<size_t>(rank);\n    const size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(numProcs);\n    const size_t base = numNodes / p;\n    const size_t rem = numNodes % p;\n    return { r * base + std::min(r, rem), base + (r < rem ? 1 : 0) };\n}\n\n// Rank that owns global row `row` under rowBlockOf\nint ownerOfRow(const size_t row, const int numProcs, const size_t numNodes) {\n    const size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(numProcs);\n    const size_t base = numNodes / p;\n    const size_t rem = numNodes % p;\n    const size_t bigRows = rem * (base + 1);\n    if (row < bigRows) {\n        return static_cast<int>(row / (base + 1));\n    }\n    return static_cast<int>(rem + (row - bigRows) / base);\n}\n\n// Fills this rank's rows of the distance matrix. Every rank replays the same rand_r\n// sequence as the serial version so the values match exactly, but keeps only its own rows.\nvoid initializeDistanceRows(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes, const RowBlock& rows,\n                            const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n\n    const size_t firstFlat = rows.start * numNodes;\n    const size_t endFlat = (rows.start + rows.count) * numNodes;\n    dist.assign(rows.count * numNodes, 0);\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < endFlat; ++i) {\n        const unsigned int value = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n        if (i >= firstFlat) {\n            dist[i - firstFlat] = value;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < rows.count; ++i) {\n        dist[i * numNodes + rows.start + i] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Path entry (i, j) starts as i, matching the serial initialization\nvoid initializePathRows(std::vector<unsigned int>& path, const size_t numNodes, const RowBlock& rows) {\n    path.resize(rows.count * numNodes);\n    for (size_t i = 0; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfyLekrYzR5nz19XdHhmF","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I've parallelized the Floyd-Warshall benchmark with MPI. The results match the original serial algorithm for every size and rank count I tested, and the build is clean apart from warnings from OpenMPI's own headers.\n\n**Results at n=2048** (run on this 256-core machine; the serial figure is the original algorithm's time):\n\n| Ranks | Computation time | GOPS |\n|---|---|---|\n| serial original | ~9.6 s wall | — |\n| 1 | 3012 ms | 2.85 |\n| 4 | 832 ms | 10.3 |\n| 8 | 415 ms | 20.7 |\n| 16 | 250 ms | 34.3 |\n| 32 | 239 ms | 35.9 |\n\nScaling is near-linear up to 16 ranks. It flattens at 32 for n=2048 because each rank's share becomes small relative to the per-step communication. Larger n should scale further, but I did not measure that.\n\n**Design:**\n- **Decomposition:** block distribution of rows across ranks. Each Floyd-Warshall step needs only the pivot row, so each step broadcasts one row and no column exchange is needed.\n- **Overlap:** the owner of the next pivot row updates it first and starts a non-blocking broadcast, so communication overlaps with the rest of the current step's work.\n- **Initialization:** every rank replays the same `rand_r` sequence as the original and keeps only its own rows, so the input matrix is identical.\n- **Gathering:** the full matrix is gathered to rank 0 only when `-r` or `-v` is given. Results and validation print on rank 0 only.\n- **Semantics:** the relaxation is the same min-update in the same k order. I checked that row k and column k are unchanged during step k, which is what makes the distributed update exact. The inner loop is branch-free and vectorizes under `-O3 -march=native`.\n\n**Verification:** the original file was overwritten and the repo isn't under git, so I rebuilt the original serial algorithm in `/tmp` as a reference. Across n ∈ {1, 2, 3, 7, 64, 100, 257, 512} and 1–8 ranks, the distance-matrix hash and sampled values match, `-v` passes, and the path matrix matches too (checked in a throwaway copy, since the program doesn't print it). Edge cases work: `-h`, unknown options (exit 1 on all ranks), `-n 0`, and n smaller than the rank count.\n\n**Changes in the repo:**\n- `floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp`: the MPI implementation. `idx2` and `validateResult` are unchanged.\n- `floydwarshall/CMakeLists.txt`: `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)` and linking `MPI::MPI_CXX`. The executable name is unchanged.\n\n**Choices you may want to revisit:**\n- **Pure MPI, no OpenMP.** One rank per core is the approach you asked for. A hybrid would be a separate change.\n- **One new output line:** `MPI ranks: N`, printed after the header. Tell me if any tooling parses the header and you'd rather I remove it.\n- **Timing:** the timer is bracketed by barriers and reports the slowest rank. GOPS is computed from the precise elapsed time rather than the truncated millisecond value, so it can differ slightly from the old figures.\n- **Path matrix:** it is still computed and maintained, as in the original, but it isn't printed, so it isn't gathered.\n\nI built out-of-tree in `/tmp`, so the repo has no build artifacts. I haven't committed anything."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1333,"cache_read_input_tokens":57089,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1333},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"58dd3f36-a1d4-435a-a71f-72227fa23db9","uuid":"66a4f7dc-e43c-4157-90e3-6a6f8ba7619f","timestamp":"2026-10-13T01:06:32.817Z","request_id":"req_011CfyLekP2YcxscnMHafLDe"}
